51133891.DESCRIPTION: Binding affinity to PARP1 (unknown origin) by ITC
51133891.references_previous: Reference [37] not found in bibliography. Reference [38] not found in bibliography. Reference [39] not found in bibliography.

original_paragraph.Materials and Methods: The inhibition of compounds on PARP-1 enzymatic activity in vitro was determined by ELISA as described previously [37–39]. The inhibition of compounds on PARP-2 enzymatic activity in vitro was determined by ELISA. Recombinant human PARP-2 was expressed and purified in our laboratory. The assay was conducted in 96-well plates. Each well of the plate was precoated with histone (30 ng/mL) diluted in 100 μL of PBS buffer (10 mM NaH2PO4, 10 mM Na2HPO4, 150 mM NaCl, pH 8.0) by incubation at 37 °C overnight.
original_paragraph.ITC Measurements: Determination of crystal structures, ITC Measurements, The PDB codes for three complex structures are 5XSR (PARP-1/13), 5XST (PARP-1/15) and 5XSU (PARP-1/31), respectively. Authors will release the atomic coordinates and experimental data upon article publication. CCDC 1587920 (S-134) contains the supplementary crystallographic data for this paper. These data can be obtained free of charge from the Cambridge Crystallographic Data Centre via http://www.ccdc.cam.ac.uk/data_request/cif. Supplementary data related to this article can be found at https://doi.org/10.1016/j.ejmech.2018.01.018.
original_paragraph.Figure 2 caption: Fig. 2. Co-crystal structures of PARP-1 catalytic domain bound with compounds 13 (A), 15 (B) and 31 (C). The PDB codes for three complex structures are 5XSR (PARP-1/13), 5XST (PARP-1/15) and 5XSU (PARP-1/31), respectively. Distances of H-bonds between the side chain of E763 and NH in the tetrahydropyridine ring are labeled in A.
